what: Makefile shard registration is unconditional while Item 4 script work is verify-first skippable
scenario_or_breakage: Failure mode 4 says the Makefile target is gated on script presence but ### UPDATED: Makefile has no verify-first guard; if scripts/check-scope-reduction-marker.sh is still absent post-#3548 an implementer can add test-check-scope-reduction-marker and a shard entry whose recipe invokes a missing script breaking make lint
suggested_fix: Mark Makefile edits verify-first with the same observable gate as Item 4: test -f scripts/check-scope-reduction-marker.sh (or test -x) before adding .PHONY recipe and shard entry; omit the Makefile subsection entirely when the helper is absent
